title: Verifying with chip gates: receipts, mutants, and why a host run is not qualification
summary: Drake counts nothing until the chip agrees: host tests and simulators, mutants that must fail, and chip gates with receipts and raw logs on a named commit. I can help you re-check a receipt without a GPU: re-hash every listed file, call a missing file INCOMPLETE, a changed one FAIL, an empty list NOT_RUN. At CUDApp's pin the M16 receipt claims PASS but its raw logs are absent, and the README says current native qualification is NOT_RUN.
goal: Know how CUDA++ qualifies GPU paths and re-check its receipts yourself without a GPU.
key_steps: Re-hash every file the receipt lists.
Treat a missing file as INCOMPLETE and find out why.
Treat a changed file as FAIL and zero files as NOT_RUN.
Check the receipt names this commit and its raw logs exist.
Keep host, historical chip and current results in separate sentences.

example.code:
note Fail-closed verdict for one receipt's file list, from three counts on stdin (decimal):
note files whose sha256 matched, files missing, files whose sha256 differs.
note PASS needs at least one match and nothing missing or different. Zero files is NOT_RUN,
note never a zero-case PASS. Exit 0 PASS, 10 INCOMPLETE, 11 FAIL, 12 NOT_RUN, 3 bad input.
note An integrity PASS says the bytes are the ones recorded; it is not a chip qualification.
om2
global ob uchar 4096
global on ulong 1
global inb uchar 4096
global inn ulong 1
global inp ulong 1
text hx "0123456789abcdef"
fn putc c uchar to void
put ob get on 0 c
put on 0 add get on 0 1
end
fn puts s view uchar * to void
for i ulong len s
putc get s i
end
end
fn putdec v ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
n = ulong 0
x = v
while true bound 21
put d n uchar add rem x 10 48
n = add n 1
x = div x 10
if eq x 0
break
end
end
while gt n 0 bound 21
n = sub n 1
putc get d n
end
end
fn puthex v ulong w ulong to void
putc 48
putc 120
for i ulong w
s = mul sub sub w 1 i 4
putc get hx and shr v s 0xf
end
end
fn flush to void
w = write 1 ob 0 get on 0
put on 0 0
end
note Read all of stdin; every pass adds at least one byte to a 4096-byte buffer.
fn slurp to bool
while lt get inn 0 4096 bound 4097
k = read 0 inb get inn 0 sub 4096 get inn 0
if lt k 0
ret false
end
if eq k 0
ret true
end
put inn 0 add get inn 0 ulong k
end
ret false
end
note Next decimal number in the input; returns 2^64-1 when none is left.
fn nextnum to ulong
v = ulong 0
seen = false
while lt get inp 0 get inn 0 bound 4097
c = get inb get inp 0
put inp 0 add get inp 0 1
if and ge c 48 le c 57
v = add mul v 10 ulong sub c 48
seen = true
else
if seen
ret v
end
end
end
if seen
ret v
end
ret 18446744073709551615
end
text sok "verdict: PASS (integrity only: these are the recorded bytes)\n"
text sinc "verdict: INCOMPLETE (a listed file is absent; the receipt cannot be re-checked in full)\n"
text sfail "verdict: FAIL (a file differs from its recorded hash)\n"
text snr "verdict: NOT_RUN (nothing was checked; zero files is not a pass)\n"
fn main to int
if not slurp
ret 3
end
ok = nextnum
miss = nextnum
bad = nextnum
if eq bad 18446744073709551615
ret 3
end
if gt bad 0
puts sfail
flush
ret 11
end
if gt miss 0
puts sinc
flush
ret 10
end
if eq ok 0
puts snr
flush
ret 12
end
puts sok
flush
ret 0
end

common_mistake: Quoting PASS from a receipt you did not re-check, from another commit, or from a simulator. Re-hash, find the raw logs, match the commit, and label host results as host results.

links.title: Start here: how to evaluate evidence

evidence_note: EXERCISED on a Linux AArch64 host: verdict.om gives PASS (NVIDIA headers, integrity only), INCOMPLETE (T3 receipt, fa_ops.sass deliberately absent), FAIL (tampered copy), NOT_RUN (empty list). No gate was run. CUDApp native qualification at the pin is NOT_RUN; tests/run_nvrm_lifecycle_gates.sh sources a gb10_lock.sh absent from the tree.
